findings.title: 監査台帳(CROSS_LEDGER)・KPI・lineage が store を subscribe しない静的 fixture で、操作者の決定・手動起票が一切記録されず append-only 完全性が破綻
findings.evidence: store-truth wiring (option a): src/store/hooks.ts:66-68 useCrossLedger returns [...CROSS_LEDGER, ...s.auditEvents]; reducer logEvent (reducer.ts:48-66) appends to auditEvents on case/create(手動起票 reducer.ts:197), approve(reducer.ts:89,95), override, sendback, escalate, reverse. Observatory.tsx:73 consumes useCrossLedger() and ledger filter (Observatory.tsx:76) operates on the live merged ledger so CASE-MANUAL-NNN now appears. Honest disclaimers (option b): Observatory.tsx:239 ledger header states session ops (起票/承認/差戻し) are appended (mock); Observatory.tsx:430 KPI note states KPIs are a separate (過去30日想定) population that session ops do NOT recalculate. Wiring proven by src/__tests__/store/audit-events.test.ts:23-31 (seed empty → 手動起票 appends 1).
findings.concern: Lifecycle view remains pinned to OBS_CASE_ID=CASE-2026-0142 (Observatory.tsx:178) by design — it is the single-case canonical view; the cross-case append surface is the ledger tab. This is a reasonable design choice, not a defect, but a regulator wanting a lifecycle view of a session-created case still cannot get one (only the flat ledger reflects it). KPI numerically stays frozen, now honestly disclosed as a separate population rather than recalculated — satisfies expectedFlawless option (b) but is not the live-recompute of option (a).

findings.title: 最頻 semantic token (primary chip/nav, neutral muted) が WCAG AA 未達で全 74/74 evidence cell が color-contrast serious — 全 route 横断の systemic a11y 欠陥
findings.evidence: Tokens added: src/index.css:23 --color-primary-strong:#4f46e5 (computed 5.62:1 on #eef2ff, 6.01:1 on #f8fafc — AA pass) and index.css:18 --color-fg-tertiary:#475569 (6.92:1 on #f1f5f9 inset). Components migrated: MetaChip.tsx:17, StatusBadge.tsx:31, FilterChip.tsx:53, Sidebar.tsx:115 all use text-[var(--color-primary-strong)] on primary-soft; neutral tone uses fg-tertiary (MetaChip:15, StatusBadge:28); PrototypeModeLabel.tsx:35 uses fg-tertiary on panel-inset. Negative-grep: 0 hits for text-[var(--color-primary)] as text and 0 raw #635bff/#64748b hex in active src (legacy excluded). Old failing combos confirmed below AA: #635bff/#eef2ff=4.20, #64748b/#f1f5f9=4.34.
findings.concern: 4 RESIDUAL static fg-muted-on-panel-inset combos remain at 4.34:1 (AA serious fail) rendering meaningful text: ReasonDialog.tsx:112 ({outcome}), LoadingState.tsx:37 (spinner message), FieldActionModal.tsx:159 & 272 (確定済み/確認 notes). These are inside modal/loading states NOT exercised by the static 15-route axe scan, so the BUILD-PROGRESS '74/74→0/74 cell' claim is true for measured routes but understates latent failures in interactive states. The design-gate script (scripts/check-design.mjs) has no fg-muted-on-inset rule (grep: 0 hits), so these are not gate-caught and could regress silently. Fix: swap text-[var(--color-fg-muted)] → text-[var(--color-fg-tertiary)] in those 4 spots. | RESOLVED post-verification: 4 residual fg-muted-on-panel-inset spots (ReasonDialog / LoadingState / FieldActionModal x2) を fg-tertiary に置換 (4.34→6.9:1)。axe sweep を modal/loading 状態へ拡張し 22 surface で serious/critical=0 を再確認。

findings.title: Approvals 等で単一案件 queue 時に filter chip が 1 候補のみの退化 UI、rowHref が機能しない歴史的 query ?view=checker を保持

[judgment, CR 報告済]: 中核欠陥 (dead query ?view=checker + 退化 1-option filter 表示) は修正・検証済。suggestedFix の「seed 複数件で queue を既定 multi-row 化」は、1-option filter を隠す現挙動が正しい UX であり filter 充填目的の seed 増は artificial padding と判断し defer。
